name: SD: Brewery on water and yeast (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A small brewery, counted every day: malt in store, beer fermenting, beer in kegs, the water tank and the yeast on hand. Mashing uses up 3 hL of water per hL of beer and racking into kegs 0.5 hL more; pitching into the fermenter uses 0.2 kg of yeast per hL. Yeast is harvested back from the fermenter and bought when it runs low; the wort cooling between mash and fermenter is not counted. A bigger fermenter arrives partway through (an announced era). The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-brewery/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests co-flows: two flows using one stock at different rates, and a used stock the system itself produces.
